decisions.reason: As a shop template closely linked to the firm's hosting and online shop customer base, it fits existing knowledge well and can be refined through the firm's established technical and service capabilities.
A responsive website template is strongly related to the firm's CMS and web project business, so the firm is well placed to learn from early uptake and improve it commercially.
Premium customer support directly extends the firm's core service model and uses capabilities it already has in 24/7 expert operations, making commercial learning and scaling highly feasible.

A software version management tool builds on the firm's technical know-how, in-house development, and platform orientation, giving it strong absorptive capacity to develop and integrate the product further.

An online tool for creating data processing contracts is comparatively distant from the firm's main hosting and platform knowledge base, so the firm is less likely to interpret feedback well and improve it efficiently relative to core innovations.
